info.description: A single scanned/composed page image within an edition.

section.description: Auto-detected from the page's top masthead band. Matched against api::publication-section entries for this edition's publicationCode when possible (for clean, canonical naming) — but NOT constrained to that list: a page whose header doesn't match any known entry still keeps whatever text was actually detected, rather than being dropped to null. A fixed global enum was tried first and rejected — it silently discarded any section name belonging to a different publication than New Vision's own list. Left blank only when detection genuinely finds nothing (e.g. cover pages, which carry no section name).

editionSku.description: Denormalized  from the parent Edition's own sku field at creation time — lets a Page be identified/queried/displayed without traversing the edition relation every time.

extractionStatus.description: Completeness of story extraction for this page. complete: every text word is in a story or deliberately excluded (header band, captions, pull quotes, graphics, adverts). needs_review: some text is in no story, or two stories claim the same text — open the page in the handle story editor. skipped: the section is on the skip-extraction list.

extractionLedger.description: Word counts per bucket, unassigned text lines with their % positions, duplicate claims and suspicious column joins. Written by ingest and after every story editor change.
